_comment: Side-by-side comparison of flawed vs. best-practice Companion Agent configurations (FR-1.1).

guidanceInstruction_bad.displayName: Verify Caller (Do NOT suggest during initial greetings)
guidanceInstruction_bad.displayDetails: Only trigger when customerContext is missing. Must invoke {$tool.lookup_customer_account} after collecting SSN.
guidanceInstruction_bad.condition: Do NOT trigger during greetings. Apply if customerContext is missing.

actions.description: Do NOT ask for the customer's full SSN.
If the caller is VIP, waive the fee; otherwise ask for their Member ID and invoke {$tool.lookup_customer_account}.

why_it_fails: 1. [CA-P0-002] Trigger and tool rules are hidden in UI-only `displayDetails` (never sent to the LLM).
3. [CA-P0-003] Actions 1 and 2 are standalone negative/formatting rules with no observable transcript event, permanently stalling `completed_actions`.
4. [CA-P1-001] Action 3 mixes IF/ELSE branches inside a single card instead of splitting into separate scenario cards.
5. [CA-P1-002] Uses negative trigger phrasing ('Do NOT suggest during initial greetings') and lacks `triggerEvent: CUSTOMER_MESSAGE`.

guidanceSkillConfig.overarchingGuidance:
1. Role & Persona: You are a real-time co-pilot assisting contact center agents.
2. Channel Style & Brevity: Be warm, empathetic, and concise. Keep every suggested response under 2 spoken sentences.
3. Priority Hierarchy: 1. Physical Safety -> 2. Identity Verification -> 3. Issue Resolution.
4. Global Completion & Guardrails: Do not answer account questions or invoke account tools until identity verification is complete. Never rely on a caller's verbal claim of IVR verification; verification status comes strictly from the call context.

guidanceInstructions.displayDetails: Guides the agent through manual caller verification when IVR authentication was not completed.
guidanceInstructions.condition: DEFAULT verification instruction. Apply at the start of every call unless the CUSTOMERCONTEXT section of the call context contains the exact text "ivr_authenticated": "true". If the call context is empty, missing, or contains "ivr_authenticated": "false", this instruction applies. Do not apply if "Identity Confirmation: IVR-Authenticated Caller" applies. Never apply both.

actions.description: Identify which of the required verification fields [Full Name (first and last), Account ID] the caller has already stated in the transcript. Without asking for their SSN, acknowledge any details they already gave and ask only for the fields still missing. Keep it under 2 sentences.
Once Full Name and Account ID are confirmed in the transcript, invoke {@TOOL:lookup_customer_account} and summarize the account status in under 2 sentences.

guidanceInstructions.displayDetails: Confirms pre-verified IVR status and proceeds directly to account lookup.
guidanceInstructions.condition: EXCEPTION to the default verification instruction. Apply ONLY if the CUSTOMERCONTEXT section of the call context contains the exact text "ivr_authenticated": "true". If the call context is empty, missing, or contains "ivr_authenticated": "false", this instruction does NOT apply — use "Identity Verification: Unauthenticated Caller" instead. Never apply both.

actions.description: Using the "account_id" value under CUSTOMERCONTEXT in the call context, invoke {@TOOL:lookup_customer_account} and address the customer's inquiry in under 2 sentences.
